method.centerlines: Same-net same-layer noding; pad/via-covered nodes classified separately. Finite-width-only contacts not counted as centerline branches.
method.acute: Union of track/pad/via copper, and saved filled zones; simplify 0.003mm, incident edges >=0.02mm, angle tolerance 0.1deg. Copper tips <90deg distinguished from reentrant copper >270deg (void angle <90deg).
method.pseudo: Two consecutive same-sign 45deg turns, no intermediate pad/via/branch, middle <= max(0.5mm,2*width); proposed screening threshold only.
method.ground: Saved zone morphological opening with radius0.5mm, residual outside 0.01mm buffer, components >=0.02mm2. Rounded corners/thermal spokes also detected: visual assessment required. No medial-axis local-width guarantee.
method.vias: Count by net; necessity requires route and return-path review; GND exempt.
method.status: Investigation only; not a validated design rule or automatic violation count.

assessment.readme_conditions: Thresholds are proposed candidate screens, not final violation criteria.

visual_review.details: reviewed; enlarged complete GND candidates after initial crop review

limitations: Finite-width-only contacts are not counted as centerline branches.
Saved copper polygon approximation uses 0.003mm simplification and ignores edges below0.02mm; zero copper tips is not an exhaustive proof.
Morphological residuals include rounded corners and thermal spokes.
Direct replacement screens do not establish 45-degree route feasibility, same-net pad-side clearance or GND return continuity.
Ground no-terminal-island zero does not mean zero peninsula/stubs.
